senses.gloss: m. (עָרָה II) pouring from vessel to vessel, emptying.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 1:4:11">Y. Maasr. I, end, 49ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ ככלי ראשון הוא</he> a boiling liquid poured from a vessel is considered like a boiling liquid in the original vessel; Y. Sabb. III, 6 top. Y. Ab. Zar. V, 45ᵃ <he>כל הע׳ מחמת הגוי</he> the emptying of the wine is done entirely by the effort of the gentile; a. e.
